NS-E101.title: This PC cannot run Nightshift
NS-E101.whatToDo: Nightshift needs 64-bit Windows 10 or 11. Tell the developer

NS-E102.title: No NVIDIA graphics card found
NS-E102.whatToDo: Install the NVIDIA driver from nvidia.com/drivers, restart, then press Check again

NS-E103.title: NVIDIA driver too old
NS-E103.whatToDo: Install the newest driver from the page that opened, restart, then press Check again

NS-E104.title: Not enough free disk space
NS-E104.whatToDo: Free 60 GB, or pick another drive

NS-E105.title: A download site cannot be reached
NS-E105.whatToDo: Check the internet, switch off any VPN or proxy, then press Retry

NS-E108.title: The graphics card libraries did not load
NS-E108.whatToDo: Press Copy diagnostics and send the zip. Nothing else to do

NS-E109.title: A downloaded file is damaged
NS-E109.whatToDo: Press Retry. Setup downloads that file again. If the same error comes back, send the diagnostics zip

NS-E110.title: A free tool did not install
NS-E110.whatToDo: Press Retry once. If it stops again, install FFmpeg yourself (winget install Gyan.FFmpeg in a terminal), then press Retry

NS-E111.title: winget is not available
NS-E111.whatToDo: Nothing to do: setup downloads FFmpeg and the Visual C++ runtime directly. To use winget later, install "App Installer" from the Microsoft Store

NS-E112.title: Caption timing cannot use the graphics card
NS-E112.whatToDo: Press Copy diagnostics and send the zip. Nothing else to do

NS-E115.title: The program files could not be copied
NS-E115.whatToDo: Close any window that shows the install folder, make sure the install folder is not the folder you extracted the zip to, then press Retry

NS-E114.title: A Windows component is missing
NS-E114.whatToDo: Setup could not install the Visual C++ runtime. Press Retry and click Yes when Windows asks for permission, or install it from aka.ms/vs/17/release/vc_redist.x64.exe

NS-E113.title: Windows Security blocked a file
NS-E113.whatToDo: Open Windows Security, then Protection history, allow the Nightshift file and press Retry. Adding the install folder as an exclusion stops it happening again

NS-W113.title: A custom model is not checked
NS-W113.whatToDo: Nightshift cannot verify a file you chose yourself. Use only models you trust. Nothing else to do

NS-W115.title: The driver version could not be read
NS-W115.whatToDo: Setup works and uses the CUDA 12.4 build. If a video fails on the graphics card later, install the newest driver from nvidia.com/drivers

NS-W114.title: The designed voice has to wait
NS-W114.whatToDo: The voice design model is not part of this install, so the voice cannot be created yet. Get it in Settings, Models, then design the voice again

NS-E202.title: A Nightshift service did not start
NS-E202.whatToDo: Press Retry once. If it stops again, send the diagnostics zip

NS-E203.title: A model took too long to start
NS-E203.whatToDo: Press Retry once. If it stops again, send the diagnostics zip

NS-E204.title: The nightly task could not be set up
NS-E204.whatToDo: Setup still works. Start videos from the dashboard and send the diagnostics zip

NS-W205.title: The nightly task runs only while you are logged on
NS-W205.whatToDo: Windows refused the unattended mode. Stay logged in overnight (lock the screen, do not sign out). Nothing else to do

NS-W206.title: The nightly task was not set up
NS-W206.whatToDo: Setup carried on without it. Start videos from the dashboard, or ask for help with the nightly task later

NS-E501.title: The Pexels key was not accepted
NS-E501.whatToDo: Copy the key again from the website (no spaces) and paste it

NS-E502.title: The Pixabay key was not accepted
NS-E502.whatToDo: Copy the key again from the website (no spaces) and paste it

NS-E503.title: The internet dropped
NS-E503.whatToDo: Check the connection, then press Retry

NS-W106.title: The install drive is a hard disk
NS-W106.whatToDo: Models load slowly from a hard disk. Pick an SSD drive if you have one

NS-W107.title: The PC cannot wake itself at night
NS-W107.whatToDo: Open Power Options, Change plan settings, Change advanced power settings, Sleep, Allow wake timers, and choose Enable. "Important wake timers only" is not enough for the 03:00 run

NS-W112.title: Long file paths are off
NS-W112.whatToDo: Setup works. Press Fix it to turn them on (Windows asks for permission)

NS-W301.title: Using the backup voice engine
NS-W301.whatToDo: Voices sound the same and take a little longer. Nothing to do

NS-W302.title: Faster decoding was not faster here

NS-W401.title: Using the slower video encoder
NS-W401.whatToDo: Update the NVIDIA driver when you can. Videos still work

NS-W403.title: The setup test video could not be made
NS-W403.whatToDo: Setup is complete. Make your first video from the dashboard. If that also fails, send the diagnostics zip

answers.json.title: Something unexpected stopped setup
answers.json.whatToDo: Press Retry once. If it stops again, press Copy diagnostics and send the zip

unexpected.title: Something unexpected stopped setup
unexpected.whatToDo: Press Retry once. If it stops again, press Copy diagnostics and send the zip
